## Shared scenes

> Captain Jim entertains [Anne](../character/anne.md), [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and [Doctor Dave](../character/doctor-dave.md) by telling the romantic story of the house's first bride and her schoolmaster husband. Afterwards, he bids his hosts farewell and shares with [Anne](../character/anne.md) their common bond as 'kindred spirits.'
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE

> Captain Jim and [Anne](../character/anne.md) bond over their shared nature as "kindred spirits," or people who belong to the race that knows [Joseph](../character/joseph.md). As the guests prepare to leave in the moonlight, Captain Jim shares stories and praises the beauty of [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds). After everyone departs, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) walk through their garden, grateful for their happy home.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) reflect on their happy honeymoon month at [Four Winds Harbor](../codex/places.md#four-winds-harbor) and Gilbert's successful emergency medical case. Later, Miss Cornelia [Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) arrives to call on [Anne](../character/anne.md), bringing her sewing and offering her sharp, frank opinions on men, local neighbors, and church denomination differences while [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) listens in from the office.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL

> Miss Cornelia shares her opinionated views on men, local ministers, and former residents, including [Elizabeth Russell](../character/elizabeth-russell.md) and Captain Jim. [Anne](../character/anne.md) asks for a recommendation for garden work, and Miss Cornelia accepts Anne's invitation to stay for tea, noting that [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) has been listening and laughing from the next room.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) goes for a evening walk on the shore of [Four Winds Harbor](../codex/places.md#four-winds-harbor) and encounters [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md), her mysterious neighbor. They share a conversation about their surroundings, beauty, and pasts before agreeing to exchange visits. Returning home, [Anne](../character/anne.md) discusses her encounter and impressions of [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md).
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 10 LESLIE MOORE

She details Leslie's tragic childhood, forced marriage to [Dick Moore](../character/dick.md), and the accident that left [Dick](../character/dick.md) an imbecile whom [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) must now care for. [Anne](../character/anne.md) listens with deep sympathy as Miss Cornelia explains Leslie's enduring hardship.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE

[Anne](../character/anne.md) promises to do all she can to reach out to the lonely, tragic [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md), and Miss Cornelia reassures [Anne](../character/anne.md) of Leslie's true [Presbyterian](../codex/factions.md#presbyterian) faith.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE

Despite relaxing and showing her warm, joyful side during the visit, she becomes distant again when leaving as she reflects on what she lacks. After [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) departs, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) share a tender moment discussing beauty and Anne's hair color.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 12 LESLIE COMES OVER

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) walks through a foggy evening to visit [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md), but turns back after seeing [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) weeping intensely in private. Outside, she meets Captain Jim leading [Dick Moore](../character/dick.md) home; Captain Jim then walks [Anne](../character/anne.md) back to her house while they discuss [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) and Dick's tragic situation.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 13 A GHOSTLY EVENING

>

> — v4 · CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT FOUR WINDS

After [Anne](../character/anne.md) hints at her pregnancy, [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) reacts coldly but later gifts her a handmade baby dress. Meanwhile, Captain Jim shares his journal of sea adventures with [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), who hope someone will one day write his life story.

> — v4 · CHAPTER 17 A FOUR WINDS WINTER

When [Susan Baker](../character/susan.md) returns with news about a sick neighbor, her unconscious funny remark causes Captain Jim and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) to step outside to laugh.

> — v4 · CHAPTER 18 SPRING DAYS

>

> — v4 · CHAPTER 22 MISS CORNELIA ARRANGES MATTERS
